description: Source code for calculator view model snapshots, including command classes, snapshot classes, and conversion functions within the CalculatorApp::ViewModel::Snapshot namespace.

classes.name: UnaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a unary command with a list of command integers.

classes.name: BinaryCommand
classes.description: Represents a binary command with a single command integer.

classes.name: OperandCommand
classes.description: Represents an operand command with flags for negativity, decimal, scientific format, and a list of command integers.

classes.name: Parentheses
classes.description: Represents a parentheses command with a command integer.

classes.name: CalcManagerToken
classes.description: Token used in calculation history, containing an opcode name and command index.

classes.name: CalcManagerHistoryItem
classes.description: Represents a history item with tokens, commands, expression, and result.

classes.name: PrimaryDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of the primary display value and error state.

classes.name: ExpressionDisplaySnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of expression tokens and commands.

classes.name: StandardCalculatorSnapshot
classes.description: Comprehensive snapshot including history, display, and expression.
